final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), 'Unknown') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), 'Unknown')), shares AS (SELECT award_count, 1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share FROM hand_counts) SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM shares WHERE share > average_share
